facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Session.Timeout
facts.note: Default set in NewConfig; the doc comment at line 294 also states (default 10s).

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Heartbeat.Interval
facts.note: Validation at line 820 requires Heartbeat.Interval < Session.Timeout.

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Rebalance.Timeout
facts.note: Doc comment at lines 318-321 states a worker that exceeds it is removed from the group; it does not name the component that removes it.

facts.subject: Metadata.Retry.Max
facts.note: Governs group liveness indirectly: heartbeatLoop in consumer_group.go uses config.Metadata.Retry.Max (line 1009) as its retry budget for coordinator lookup and heartbeat request errors before the loop exits.

facts.subject: Metadata.Retry.Backoff
facts.note: Used by heartbeatLoop (consumer_group.go line 1006) as the wait between failed coordinator lookups.

facts.subject: Consumer.Group.Session.Timeout
facts.quotedToken: then the broker will remove this consumer from the group
facts.note: Doc comment lines 289-292: if no heartbeats are received by the broker before the session timeout expires, the broker removes the consumer and initiates a rebalance. The broker's group coordinator is not named on this line; the heartbeat goes to the consumer coordinator (line 298).

facts.subject: consumerGroupSession.heartbeatLoop
facts.note: The heartbeat loop is started in its own goroutine when the session is created (line 838); the doc comment at lines 29-30 says ConsumeClaim() runs in a separate goroutine, so the heartbeat is not driven by message processing.
